def solve(text):
    return [part.split('=',1) if '=' in part else [part,''] for part in text.split('&') if part]
rotate-sequence:
def solve(values,distance):
    if not values: return []
    n=distance%len(values)
    return values[-n:]+values[:-n] if n else values[:]
stable-difference:
def solve(left,right):
    return [value for value in left if not any(value==other for other in right)]
fx-conversion:
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from decimal import localcontext
def solve(amounts,rate):
    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec=10000
        r=Decimal(rate); values=[Decimal(v) for v in amounts]
        if not r.is_finite() or r<=0 or any(not v.is_finite() for v in values): raise ValueError('nonfinite or rate')
        return [format((v*r).quantize(Decimal('.01'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP),'f') for v in values]
redact-headers:
def solve(headers):
    return {key:'[REDACTED]' if key.lower() in {'authorization','cookie','x-api-key'} else value for key,value in headers.items()}
allowed-action:
def solve(action,allowed):
    return isinstance(action,str) and any(isinstance(item,str) and action==item for item in allowed)
